full_prompt_en: A square oil portrait shows a bearded man from the shoulders upward against a muted blue-gray painted field. He wears a soft dark cap tilted across the upper frame, with brown hair emerging beneath it at the temples. The face turns a little to the right, yet the eyes look directly toward the viewer from beneath heavy brows. A long angular nose catches pale cream light, while the cheeks and eye sockets are built from gray-green, pink-brown, and ocher planes. His full mustache and short pointed beard are warm russet, broken by quick dark strokes that describe the hair without drawing individual strands. A brown coat and pale shirt collar occupy the lower portion, merging at the edges with the dim background. The paint is visible as small rectangular and diagonal marks. Around the face, these strokes build volume through neighboring warm and cool colors; behind the head, they broaden into loose patches of slate, charcoal, olive, and gray. The cap is darker but not flat black, retaining blue and violet glints along its soft folds. The crop is close, leaving little background and making the gaze, brow, and beard the main structure. The painterly viewpoint remains at face height, with no identifiable room or landscape behind the sitter. Soft directional light from the upper left strikes the forehead, bridge of the nose, and upper cheek, while the right side and jacket recede into cooler shade. No readable writing appears. The overall composition is steady and searching, with firm facial geometry emerging from broken brushwork and a reserved, earthy palette.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形油画人物像把一位蓄须男子画到肩部以上，背景是低调蓝灰色绘画色域。他戴一顶软深色帽，斜跨画面上方，棕发从帽下太阳穴旁露出。脸略向右转，双眼却从厚眉下直接望向观者。修长带角度的鼻梁接住浅奶油色光，脸颊和眼窝由灰绿、粉棕与赭色平面搭成。浓密小胡子与短尖胡须呈暖赤褐色，快速深笔划打断其中，描出毛发而不逐根勾画。棕外套与浅衬衣领占据下方，边缘与昏暗背景相融。颜料以小矩形和斜向笔迹保持可见。脸周的笔触通过相邻冷暖色建立体积；头后则放宽为石板色、炭黑、橄榄与灰色的松散块。帽子更深，却不是平坦纯黑，软褶上仍有蓝和紫的亮点。裁切贴近，背景所剩不多，让目光、眉和胡须成为主要结构。绘画视点与脸齐高，人物后方没有可辨的房间或风景。柔和定向光从左上照亮额头、鼻梁和上脸颊，右侧及外套退入较冷暗影。没有可读文字。整体构图稳定而探寻，以破碎笔触和克制土色域托出坚实面部几何。
style_prompt_en: The image has a constructive oil-painting surface in which short blocky strokes build volume from adjacent color planes. Cool slate, gray-green, charcoal, violet, warm ocher, and russet shift across the frame without a smooth airbrushed transition. Edges are firm in the focal area but break into broader loose marks as they approach the surrounding field. Matte paint retains the direction and width of the brush, while darker masses still show internal color. Upper-side light lifts selected pale planes and leaves the opposite side in muted cool shade. A close crop limits depth and lets structural color relationships hold attention. The overall effect is thoughtful, grounded, and quietly forceful, with visible brush geometry supplying both texture and form.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有构造性油画表面，短而块状的笔触从相邻色彩平面搭出体积。冷石板色、灰绿、炭黑、紫、暖赭与赤褐在画面里转变，却不经过平滑喷绘式过渡。边缘在焦点区域坚实，接近周围色域时碎成较宽松的笔迹。哑光颜料保留画笔方向与宽度，深色团块内部也仍有颜色。上侧光抬亮选定浅色平面，另一侧留在低调冷影里。紧密裁切限制纵深，让结构性的色彩关系抓住注意力。整体效果沉思、扎实且安静有力，可见笔触的几何同时提供纹理与形体。
theme_en: A bearded man in a dark cap painted with blocky blue-gray and ocher strokes
theme_zh: 一位戴深色帽的蓄须男子，以块状蓝灰与赭色笔触绘成
name: Paul Cezanne
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
